title: The Slow Count
subtitle: autoSubmitTicks: 200, which is ten seconds
description: Every task is re-checked on a timer -- twenty ticks by default, so
once a second. This one says `autoSubmitTicks: 200`, so the engine
looks at your iron once every ten seconds instead.
The field exists for a task whose check is expensive, and a count of
iron is not one; it is set here so you can see where the number
goes. Nothing about the quest's behaviour changes except how often
